core.title: 2-5/8 Inch Smooth Iron Cup Pull, Acorn APTBP

text.description_html:
Acorn APTBP, Smooth Iron 2-5/8 Inch Cup Pull

The finish of the 2-5/8 Inch Smooth Iron Cup Pull is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it was originally forged. Made of iron, it has a lifetime no rust warranty. This oval shaped cup pull cabinet handle is great for drawers, furniture or cabinet doors. It is surface mounted to the door's face in the classic early american style.

Also Available: 3-1/2 Inch Smooth Iron Cup Pulls

Specification for the Smooth Black Iron Cup Pull:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Length: 2-5/8"
  • Width: 1-1/2"

Sold individually. Package includes 1 cup pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.
